design: retrospective accounting with fixed teams and saved role scores
service_assumption: all recruited participants completed their service bundles in valid archived jobs; no field service attestations
bonuses: reserved unless independent team outcome acceptance and an independently validated contribution rule were approved before settlement
hypothetical_comparator: full availability-based basic fee and unlocked Fminus CA/CM pools in every valid job
score_filter: retain score only if strictly above the archived role-specific numerical tolerance
rounding: integer largest remainder with lexicographic string-ID tie-break
comparisons: original Fminus shadow ledger, revised hypothetical shadow ledger, and main policy under archive assumptions
analysis: same 30 inversion and 15 solver pairs per team and target as Task 11; average within team then equally across 10 teams per cohort; descriptive means
